text:
Maya Patel: Quick preflight for RLS 2.3 — cut scheduled for Thu 3/25 EOD. Proposing a go/no-go sync on Tue 3/23 10:00 PT. Agenda idea: 1) roll status, 2) blockers, 3) staging smoke results, 4) rollback plan & owners, 5) stakeholder ack. Who can attend? Please RSVP and claim items you own. cc @Jordan Kim @Sam Ortiz @Aisha Khan

Sam Ortiz: I can make 10:00 PT. I'll run the staging smoke and post results by Tue 9:30 PT. Note: need a DB migration dry run — can someone confirm migration window? :eyes:

Jordan Kim: 10:00 PT works for me. I'll present canary metrics and rollback steps. @ops-bot can you post last prod deploy blackout window?

ops-bot: PROD DEPLOY BLACKOUT: 2026-03-24 00:00 — 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC. See https://deploys/internal/blackout for details.

Aisha Khan: I have a conflict at 10:00 PT. Could we move to 11:00 PT? If not I can participate async — I'll update the preflight doc and mark owners. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/rls-2.3-preflight

Leo Zhang: I can do 10:00 but prefer 11:00. If the team wants 10 I'll make it work. Also +1 for running `./scripts/staging-smoke.sh --fast` before the sync.

Maya Patel: If Aisha needs 11, I'll run a quick poll. Otherwise keeping it at 10 helps get ops validation before the blackout. React with :one: for 10:00 PT, :two: for 11:00 PT. I'll tally by EOD today.

ops-bot: Poll created — :one: 10:00 PT, :two: 11:00 PT.

Sam Ortiz: :one:

Jordan Kim: :one:

Leo Zhang: :two:

Aisha Khan: :two:

Maya Patel: Tally is 2 vs 2. To avoid forcing people, proposing 10:30 PT as a compromise. New proposed time: Tue 3/23 10:30 PT. Objections? Also assigning owners: staging smoke -> @Sam Ortiz, rollback -> @Jordan Kim, CI/egress checks -> @Leo Zhang, stakeholder pings & docs -> @Aisha Khan.

Sam Ortiz: ack — I'll run the smoke and post results as a gist.

Jordan Kim: ack. I'll prepare canary dashboards and rollback checklist.

Aisha Khan: ack. I'll ping Sales/Product/Legal for attendance and add the agenda template to the preflight doc.

Maya Patel: Agenda template (paste into preflight doc):
```
1) Roll status (owners)
2) Blockers & mitigations
3) Staging smoke results (pass/fail + logs)
4) Canary metrics & rollback plan
5) Stakeholder ack + post-cut tasks
6) Cut go/no-go vote
```
Please add items or owners to the doc by EOD Mon.

ops-bot: Staging snapshot available: s3://redwood-staging/snapshots/2026-03-17.tar.gz

Sam Ortiz: Posted smoke run results: PASS with minor grafana alerts — logs gist: https://gist.github.com/abc123 (summary in the preflight doc)

Leo Zhang: Quick note — DB migration needs schema owner sign-off. @Maria Gomez can you confirm dry-run status by Tue 9:00 PT? cc @Maria Gomez

Maria Gomez: Confirmed — migration dry run completed on staging with no blocking issues.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Final: Go/no-go sync Tue 3/23 10:30 PT. I'll send the calendar invite and lock the thread for RSVPs. If you need to swap owners, update the preflight doc or ping me directly.
